briefing: Markets sold off sharply today with the NASDAQ down 2.9% and the S&P 500 down 1.8%, putting conditions firmly in risk-off territory. No new candidates were screened today, and per strategy guidance we're holding all 7 existing positions rather than panic-selling on a single down day — stop-loss and profit-target rules will handle any positions that breach their thresholds automatically.

daily_lesson.explanation_en: A 'risk-off' day is when investors broadly sell riskier assets like growth stocks in favor of safety, often causing indexes like the NASDAQ to fall more than the broader market. The right response isn't to panic-sell your holdings, but to pause new buying and let your existing risk controls (like stop-losses) do their job.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 「風險規避」（Risk-Off）是指投資者普遍賣出成長股等風險較高的資產，轉向較安全的資產，這也是為什麼像NASDAQ這類成長股較多的指數跌幅通常會比大盤更深。正確的應對方式不是恐慌性拋售現有持股，而是暫停新進場，並讓既有的風險控管機制（例如停損）自動發揮作用。

market_education.summary_en: Broad-based selling hit growth and tech-heavy names hardest today, dragging the NASDAQ down nearly 3% and the S&P 500 down almost 2%. Days like this are often driven by shifts in rate expectations or risk sentiment rather than company-specific news, and without confirmed headlines to point to, the safest read is that investors broadly de-risked. The lack of new screened candidates reflects that very few stocks are showing the kind of strength (volume, momentum, trend) worth buying into during a selloff.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日大盤出現全面性拋售，科技股與成長股跌幅尤其明顯，NASDAQ下跌近3%，標普500指數下跌近2%。這類急跌通常反映市場對利率或整體風險情緒的轉變，而非個別公司的消息面因素；在缺乏明確新聞依據的情況下，較合理的解讀是投資者正在全面降低風險敞口。今日篩選不到新的候選標的，也正好反映在拋售行情中，很少有股票同時展現出值得進場的量能、動能與趨勢條件。
